summary_en: FY7/26 year-end dividend raised to 55.00 yen/share from prior forecast of 48.00 yen/share. Increase of 7.00 yen. Adjustment based on updated free cash flow outlook and review of cash position and shareholder return policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Kurashicom announced on 15 June 2026 a revision to its FY7/26 (ending 31 July 2026) dividend forecast, increasing the year-end dividend from the prior prediction of 48.00 yen/share to 55.00 yen/share—an increase of 7.00 yen. The second-quarter dividend remains at 0.00 yen, making the total annual dividend 55.00 yen/share.

The company stated that operating performance has progressed steadily within the range of the full-year consolidated earnings forecast announced on 12 September 2025. The revision follows an update to the free cash flow outlook for FY7/26 and a review of shareholder return methods. The company applies a dynamic capital-allocation approach based on cash position and free cash flow generation, balancing growth investment with shareholder returns.
